projects.name: Warehouse System
projects.description: In this project cargo related products are managed by warehouse staff. There are 3 modules, acceptance breakdown and buildup. The buildup is done by warehouse agents, who need to previously load the records in the system to ensure anything built up is OK to go by all standards. Warehouse agents in the smart warehouse to perform the breakdown accordingly. Warehouse personnel will then initiate the process of handling the freight according to the breakdown instructions prepared by the office agents during flight preparation. When consolidations (with multiple HWBs) are indicated to be broken down by HWB, the warehouse agent will enter the piece count at each location for each HWB.

In this project, I have worked on writing scenario using Spec flow for different region, and I have also developed new features in existing project.

projects.name: School ERP
projects.description: School ERP software is a robust, time-tested educational ERP system integrated with the advanced modules to enable faculty & educators to digitize the daily work processes of educational institutions. Also referred to as a school management system, the smart school ERP software simplifies the complex administrative & non-administrative tasks including online admission, online fees. management, examination management, assessments, timetable, schedule planning, teaching-learning, etc.

projects.name: Payroll
projects.description: Team-oriented Payroll Accountant adept at creating clear and comprehensive financial reports detailing payroll activity while efficiently managing all payroll tasks.

projects.name: Healthcare
projects.description: I worked on a Healthcare Management System developed using ASP.NET Core Web API, React, SQL Server, and Entity Framework Core. The application managed patients, doctors, appointments, prescriptions, and billing. I was responsible for creating REST APIs, implementing JWT authentication, designing database tables, optimizing Entity Framework queries, and integrating the React frontend with the .NET backend. We followed clean architecture, Dependency Injection and SOLID principles to build a scalable and maintainable application.

projects.name: Power Invoice (Window based and web based)
projects.description: It is one of the best Billing and Invoice software. It has ease of use & nice interface. Windows based Billing, Inventory Management and Accounting Software. It can handle multiple customers by allowing to hold current invoice and pick it later.
